class FlowBase { constructor(public value = 1) {} }
class FlowBranches extends FlowBase {
  constructor(flag: boolean) { if (flag) super(2); else super(3); console.log(this.value); }
}
class FlowBlock extends FlowBase {
  constructor() { { super(4); } console.log(this.value); }
}
class FlowCapture extends FlowBase {
  constructor() { const read = () => this.value; super(5); console.log(read()); }
}
class FlowUnreachable extends FlowBase {
  constructor() { if (false) console.log(this.value); super(6); console.log(this.value); }
}
new FlowBranches(true);
new FlowBranches(false);
new FlowBlock();
new FlowCapture();
new FlowUnreachable();
